::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/analytics/sync"}
#docs
`synced_at` is when the 5-minute refresh last wrote the scope's current-day figures — not an answer's `computed_at`, which is the OLDEST figure in its range. `business` narrows it; omitted, it is the organization's least-recently refreshed business. Null until anything has been written. `refresh_seconds` is the refresh interval.

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `business` | `string` | no | Limit the answer to one business (biz_…). |
| `livemode` | `string` | no | Limit the answer to `live` or `test` data, or `all`. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `analytics_sync`. One of `analytics_sync`. |
| `business` | `string` | The business id the answer is for. |
| `synced_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the figures were last refreshed. Null if they never were. |
| `refresh_seconds` | `integer` | How often the figures refresh, in seconds. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | The last refresh instant |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/analytics/sync" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```

#response
```json [200 OK]
{
  "object": "analytics_sync",
  "business": "biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01",
  "synced_at": "2026-03-14T09:30:00Z",
  "refresh_seconds": 300
}
```
::
